# 1.0.88

- Add `createStoreReplicaSet` and `createStoreReplicaOffers`: a transport-neutral, self-assembling single-authority Store network over reusable connection capabilities, with retryable sessions, cascading replay fragments, operational status, and non-electable client replicas.
- Add deterministic authority reconciliation (`epoch`, leader id, authority line), opt-in automatic promotion, injectable election/proof policy, anti-cycle paths, and observable split-brain diffs before a losing writable branch adopts the canonical keyframe.
- Add freshness-aware route selection by cumulative measured latency plus offer priority, hysteresis, and gap-free replay hand-off; direct, relay, RPC, WebRTC, worker, and in-process paths share the same offer boundary.
- Add focused failover/routing/conflict coverage, a real Socket.IO/RPC two-hop oracle, and an interactive four-node Lab demo with a live capability/session/selected-route diagram for route changes, partitions, client participation, conflict creation, and convergence.
